_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

WynnExcavation Site C#000.src: I hope all of our troubles have been settled. Now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting to attend.
WynnExcavation Site C#000.dst: Espero que todos nuestros problemas se hayan resuelto. Y ahora, si me disculpas, tengo una reunión.

WynnExcavation Site C#001.src: Talk to Excavator Placardus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site B)
WynnExcavation Site C#001.dst: Habla con el excavador Placardus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (requiere el fragmento del yacimiento B)

WynnExcavation Site C#002.src: All operations functional... Transportation on schedule... Oh. It's you. We've been looking for you.
WynnExcavation Site C#002.dst: Todo operativo... Transporte según lo previsto... Oh. Eres tú. Te estábamos buscando.
WynnExcavation Site C#002.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#003.src: Locating you was far harder than we thought, but here you are, having come right to us.
WynnExcavation Site C#003.dst: Dar contigo fue mucho más difícil de lo que pensábamos, pero aquí estás, has venido tú solito.
WynnExcavation Site C#003.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#004.src: Now you're here, I'm not sure what to say. But I feel I must explain, we at WynnExcavation apologise for all our previous encounters.
WynnExcavation Site C#004.dst: Ahora que estás aquí, no sé muy bien qué decir. Pero debo explicarme: en WynnExcavation te pedimos disculpas por todos nuestros encuentros.
WynnExcavation Site C#004.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#005.src: We completely got off on the wrong foot. We are a company from Gavel which specialises in historic artifacts of great mystical importance.
WynnExcavation Site C#005.dst: Empezamos con muy mal pie. Somos una empresa de Gavel especializada en artefactos históricos de gran importancia mística.
WynnExcavation Site C#005.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#006.src: After our encounter in {p}, we naturally thought you were a black market salesperson trying to steal pieces of the artifact for monetary gain.
WynnExcavation Site C#006.dst: Tras nuestro encuentro en {p}, dimos por hecho que vendías en el mercado negro y querías robar piezas del artefacto para lucrarte.
WynnExcavation Site C#006.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#007.src: So we instructed all of our employees in all of our sites to thwart you at any cost. Historical loss is a very important issue, especially with something so powerful.
WynnExcavation Site C#007.dst: Así que ordenamos a todos los empleados de todos nuestros yacimientos que te frenaran a toda costa. La pérdida histórica es un asunto muy serio, más aún con algo tan poderoso.
WynnExcavation Site C#007.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#008.src: But after hearing the stories of your travels in the province, we realised what had happened, and you mistook us for the enemy. This is obviously not the case.
WynnExcavation Site C#008.dst: Pero al oír las historias de tus viajes por la provincia, entendimos lo que había pasado: nos tomaste por el enemigo. Y está claro que no es así.
WynnExcavation Site C#008.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#009.src: I hope this clears everything up between us and we can both move our separate ways, now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting to attend.
WynnExcavation Site C#009.dst: Espero que esto lo aclare todo entre nosotros y que cada uno siga su camino. Y ahora, si me disculpas, tengo una reunión.
WynnExcavation Site C#009.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#010.src: Infiltrate the Excavation Meeting. The meeting is held in a diamond-pickaxe room, the portal being located to the left of the entrance to a large lava cave.
WynnExcavation Site C#010.dst: Infíltrate en la reunión de la excavación. Se celebra en una sala con un pico de diamante; el portal está a la izquierda de la entrada a una gran cueva de lava.

WynnExcavation Site C#011.src: I'm sorry. This is a private meeting.
WynnExcavation Site C#011.dst: Lo siento. Es una reunión privada.
WynnExcavation Site C#011.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#012.src: It is only my first day on the job, so I can't let you in without a pass. Sorry.
WynnExcavation Site C#012.dst: Es mi primer día, así que sin pase no puedo dejarte pasar. Lo siento.
WynnExcavation Site C#012.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#013.src: The door will be locked shortly.
WynnExcavation Site C#013.dst: La puerta se cerrará en breve.
WynnExcavation Site C#013.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#015.src: Hello and welcome, senior members of Wynn Excavation Site C. May the dark's gaze forever watch over us. I want to update you on our progress thus far. The fire relic crystal has been largely intact in the heart of the volcano for many years.
WynnExcavation Site C#015.dst: Hola y bienvenidos, miembros veteranos del yacimiento C de Wynn Excavation. Que la mirada de la oscuridad vele siempre por nosotros. Quiero informaros de nuestros avances. El cristal reliquia de fuego lleva muchos años casi intacto en el corazón del volcán.
WynnExcavation Site C#015.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#016.src: Removing it will most likely cause a chain reaction and make things difficult. Fortunately, a mage from the other side of the ocean is here to counter that. We can expect to have it moved and be shipped over to the undisclosed location any day now.
WynnExcavation Site C#016.dst: Extraerlo provocará casi seguro una reacción en cadena y complicará las cosas. Por suerte, ha venido un mago del otro lado del océano para contrarrestarlo. Podemos esperar que lo trasladen y lo envíen al lugar secreto cualquier día de estos.
WynnExcavation Site C#016.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#017.src: I would also like to inform you that the crystals removed from our possession from sites B and A have not been retrieved. However, the culprit should no longer be interested in our operations. The lost crystals did not harness any raw magic, thus are not essential to the overall scheme.
WynnExcavation Site C#017.dst: También quiero informaros de que los cristales que nos arrebataron en los yacimientos B y A no se han recuperado. Sin embargo, al culpable ya no deberían interesarle nuestras operaciones. Los cristales perdidos no contenían magia pura, así que no son esenciales para el plan general.
WynnExcavation Site C#017.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#018.src: Now, our short term goals are to move our equipment out of the heart of the volcano and start moving the fire stone for assimilation at the concealed location. All senior officers are responsible for their quadrants. Let's get this done efficiently and discreetly.
WynnExcavation Site C#018.dst: Nuestros objetivos a corto plazo son sacar el equipo del corazón del volcán y empezar a trasladar la piedra de fuego al lugar oculto para su asimilación. Cada oficial veterano responde de su cuadrante. Hagámoslo con eficacia y discreción.
WynnExcavation Site C#018.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#020.src: The alarm has been set off! There is an unauthorized guest! Guards, seize them!
WynnExcavation Site C#020.dst: ¡Ha saltado la alarma! ¡Hay un intruso! ¡Guardias, atrapadlo!
WynnExcavation Site C#020.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#021.dst: Escapa de los guardias de WynnExcavation

WynnExcavation Site C#022.src: Explore the area and search for the traitor
WynnExcavation Site C#022.dst: Explora la zona y busca al traidor

WynnExcavation Site C#023.src: You. You are the one they are worried about.
WynnExcavation Site C#023.dst: Tú. Tú eres quien les tiene tan preocupados.

WynnExcavation Site C#024.src: I am Amadel, leader of the rebellion.
WynnExcavation Site C#024.dst: Soy Amadel, líder de la rebelión.

WynnExcavation Site C#025.src: I know this is all a bit sudden, but I have some information you must hear.
WynnExcavation Site C#025.dst: Sé que todo esto es algo repentino, pero tengo información que debes oír.
WynnExcavation Site C#025.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#026.src: Everything you have been told is a lie. The Wynn Excavation “company” are not what they appear to be.
WynnExcavation Site C#026.dst: Todo lo que te han contado es mentira. La «empresa» Wynn Excavation no es lo que parece.
WynnExcavation Site C#026.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#027.src: They are using that as a front and their reach stretches further than I even know.
WynnExcavation Site C#027.dst: La usan como tapadera y su alcance llega más lejos de lo que incluso yo sé.
WynnExcavation Site C#027.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#028.src: There is no higher authority than them, not even the kings. And their intentions are not good.
WynnExcavation Site C#028.dst: No hay autoridad por encima de ellos, ni siquiera los reyes. Y sus intenciones no son buenas.
WynnExcavation Site C#028.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#029.src: They seek the ultimate power, a power hidden across Wynn by various civilizations over hundreds of years.
WynnExcavation Site C#029.dst: Buscan el poder supremo, un poder que varias civilizaciones escondieron por todo Wynn durante cientos de años.
WynnExcavation Site C#029.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#030.src: They heard about it, and of course, began to gather the ingredients to create something that would lead them to total domination of the province.
WynnExcavation Site C#030.dst: Se enteraron y, por supuesto, empezaron a reunir los ingredientes para crear algo que les diera el dominio total de la provincia.
WynnExcavation Site C#030.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#031.src: They've been on to me for some time. I can't tell you everything here, but first, you must gather parts of the crystal, like you did with the others. It is essential.
WynnExcavation Site C#031.dst: Hace tiempo que me siguen la pista. Aquí no puedo contártelo todo, pero primero debes reunir partes del cristal, como hiciste con los otros. Es esencial.
WynnExcavation Site C#031.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#032.src: The crystal is in the cave just inside the volcano past the base. Hurry, they are all off duty at the moment, the cave to the heart of the volcano is clear. Act swiftly, and good luck.
WynnExcavation Site C#032.dst: El cristal está en la cueva justo dentro del volcán, pasada la base. Date prisa, ahora están todos fuera de servicio y la cueva al corazón del volcán está despejada. Actúa rápido, y suerte.
WynnExcavation Site C#032.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#033.src: Explore the depths of the volcano

WynnExcavation Site C#034.src: Escape the volcano with the crystal shard
WynnExcavation Site C#034.dst: Escapa del volcán con el fragmento de cristal

WynnExcavation Site C#035.src: Report back to Excavator Placardus with a [Red Crystal Shard]
WynnExcavation Site C#035.dst: Vuelve con el excavador Placardus con un [Red Crystal Shard]

WynnExcavation Site C#036.src: You couldn't just take my polite word and leave it at that, could you?
WynnExcavation Site C#036.dst: No podías aceptar mi palabra educada y dejarlo estar, ¿verdad?
WynnExcavation Site C#036.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#037.src: You had to go snooping around, meddle in things that are far beyond your comprehension. No matter. Something did come out of this, it would appear.
WynnExcavation Site C#037.dst: Tenías que ir husmeando, meterte en asuntos que escapan con mucho a tu comprensión. No importa. Parece que algo bueno ha salido de todo esto.
WynnExcavation Site C#037.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#038.src: You were caught, conversing with Amadel, who we now know to be a traitor, thanks to you. There are eyes everywhere, young hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#038.dst: Te pillaron hablando con Amadel, que ahora sabemos que es un traidor, gracias a ti. Hay ojos por todas partes, joven héroe.
WynnExcavation Site C#038.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#039.src: I'm willing to bet he's already been... taken care of by senior staff.
WynnExcavation Site C#039.dst: Apuesto a que los altos cargos ya se han... ocupado de él.
WynnExcavation Site C#039.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#040.src: We also now know you are operating in the dark. You know nothing of the crystals or their power, and you know not that even the crystals you possess are inconsequential to our plans.
WynnExcavation Site C#040.dst: Ahora también sabemos que vas a ciegas. No sabes nada de los cristales ni de su poder, y ni siquiera sabes que los cristales que tienes son irrelevantes para nuestros planes.
WynnExcavation Site C#040.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#041.src: You're lucky you aren't dead. How you infiltrated us this far has shown nothing but beginner's luck for the province's new hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#041.dst: Tienes suerte de seguir con vida. Haber llegado hasta aquí no demuestra más que la suerte del principiante del nuevo héroe de la provincia.
WynnExcavation Site C#041.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#042.src: I suggest you leave, before the guards get here and you meet the same fate as Amadel. Our power is limitless; armies, resources, even royalty are on our side. Our gaze is everpresent. Now, get out of my sight!
WynnExcavation Site C#042.dst: Te sugiero que te vayas antes de que lleguen los guardias y acabes como Amadel. Nuestro poder es ilimitado: ejércitos, recursos, hasta la realeza está con nosotros. Nuestra mirada lo ve todo. ¡Y ahora, fuera de mi vista!
WynnExcavation Site C#042.speaker: Excavator Placardus
